method.calibration: fastest of 3 trials reaches 2 ms, cap 65536; bypassed with explicit repetitions
method.timed: same ti_forward checks, bias, two dense layers, ReLU, finite checks, checksum/loop overhead
method.not_timed: allocation, generation, model init, oracle, result copies, all CSV output
method.validation: all final output elements per batch plus accumulated checksum against independent oracle
method.percentiles: nearest-rank distribution of batch-average latency; not per-call tail latency
method.weights: same row-major buffers; BLAS sgemv transpose view, no prepacking or format conversion
method.floating_point: C contraction off; vendor BLAS may use FMA/reassociation; numerical tolerance, not bitwise equality
method.limitations: warm fixed synthetic data; no affinity/frequency control; process ranges are not confidence intervals
